title: AI from zero to practice
description: A step-by-step course for understanding AI, doing useful work, and sharing what you learn.

modules.title: Start with the essentials
modules.description: Get your bearings. Understand the tools, ask better questions, and learn how to check the answer.
modules.outcome: Give AI a clear task and judge the result.

modules.title: Find answers you can trust
modules.description: Work with sources, resolve conflicting information, and turn messy data into something useful.
modules.outcome: Build a sourced answer and identify what is still unknown.

modules.title: Build something useful
modules.description: Go from a small specification to a working result. Learn code, reusable skills, and meaningful checks.
modules.outcome: Ship one small, verified application flow.

modules.title: Make the work repeatable
modules.description: Understand harnesses, agents, handoffs, graphs, and automation without getting lost in the names.
modules.outcome: Choose and test a workflow with clear boundaries.

modules.title: Create with intention
modules.description: Direct images, video, and voice. Learn to preserve the details that matter when you make an edit.
modules.outcome: Create and evaluate a consistent multimedia lesson.

modules.title: Turn practice into knowledge
modules.description: Use your experiments to explain clearly, teach a small group, and publish lessons with evidence.
modules.outcome: Teach a lesson another person can reproduce.
